raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner accepted a misleading search snippet stating that William de Beauchamp, 1st Baron Bergavenny, was the son of Guy de Beauchamp, 10th Earl of Warwick (even pairing him with Katherine Mortimer, who was actually Thomas de Beauchamp’s wife). Without verifying with authoritative sources, the Planner inferred the paternal grandfather as Guy, when the correct paternal grandfather is Thomas de Beauchamp, 11th Earl of Warwick. This overreliance on an unverified snippet and failure to cross-check led to the incorrect lineage conclusion.
